name: Server Storage Pressure
checks: Identify the exact filesystem/volume that is full and current utilization.
Identify which directory, dataset, log, snapshot or workload is consuming the space.
Determine whether growth is expected, leaked, stale, or caused by retention/snapshots.
Free or expand capacity only after the consuming source is identified.
stop_condition: Stop when the capacity consumer and growth cause are identified.
resolution: Remove/rotate/relocate the confirmed consumer or expand storage where growth is legitimate.
validation: Check that growth rate is normal.
